user.title: Connect to BirdNET-Go
user.description: Bird Card will reach BirdNET-Go through Home Assistant, so recordings and live detections work anywhere Home Assistant does. Enter the address Home Assistant itself uses to reach BirdNET-Go.

data_description.url: For example http://192.168.1.50:8080, or http://db21ed7f-birdnet-go:8080 for the BirdNET-Go add-on on Home Assistant OS.
data_description.api_token: Only needed if BirdNET-Go's Private Mode is on. It stays in Home Assistant and is never sent to the browser.
data_description.verify_ssl: Turn off only for an https:// address with a self-signed certificate.

data_description.url: The address Home Assistant uses to reach BirdNET-Go.
data_description.api_token: Only needed if BirdNET-Go's Private Mode is on.
data_description.verify_ssl: Turn off only for an https:// address with a self-signed certificate.

error.invalid_url: Enter an http:// or https:// address, like http://192.168.1.50:8080.
error.cannot_connect: Home Assistant couldn't reach that address. Check the host and port from the Home Assistant machine itself.
error.ssl_error: The SSL certificate couldn't be verified. Turn off certificate verification for a self-signed certificate.
error.not_birdnet_go: Something answered, but it doesn't look like BirdNET-Go's API.
error.needs_token: BirdNET-Go asked for sign-in (Private Mode). Add an API token from BirdNET-Go's settings.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Bird Card Proxy is already set up.
